minimumDescriptionLength.description: A minimum character length for descriptions when `allow-with-description` is enabled.

ts-check.description: Whether to allow ts-check directives, and with which restrictions.

ts-expect-error.description: Whether to allow ts-expect-error directives, and with which restrictions.

ts-ignore.description: Whether to allow ts-ignore directives, and with which restrictions.

ts-nocheck.description: Whether to allow ts-nocheck directives, and with which restrictions.

checkUnknown.description: Whether to also check values of type `unknown`

allowObjectTypes.description: Whether to allow empty object type literals.

allowWithName.description: A stringified regular expression to allow interfaces and object type aliases with the configured name.

allowForKnownSafeCalls.description: Type specifiers of functions whose calls are safe to float.

allowForKnownSafePromises.description: Type specifiers that are known to be safe to float.

checkThenables.description: Whether to check all "Thenable"s, not just the built-in Promise type.

ignoreIIFE.description: Whether to ignore async IIFEs (Immediately Invoked Function Expressions).

checksConditionals.description: Whether to warn when a Promise is provided to conditional statements.

checksSpreads.description: Whether to warn when `...` spreading a `Promise`.

checksVoidReturn.description: Whether to warn when a Promise is returned from a function typed as returning `void`.

oneOf.description: Whether to disable checking all asynchronous functions.
Which forms of functions may have checking disabled.

arguments.description: Disables checking an asynchronous function passed as argument where the parameter type expects a function that returns `void`.

attributes.description: Disables checking an asynchronous function passed as a JSX attribute expected to be a function that returns `void`.

inheritedMethods.description: Disables checking an asynchronous method in a type that extends or implements another type expecting that method to return `void`.

properties.description: Disables checking an asynchronous function passed as an object property expected to be a function that returns `void`.

returns.description: Disables checking an asynchronous function returned in a function whose return type is a function that returns `void`.

variables.description: Disables checking an asynchronous function used as a variable whose return type is a function that returns `void`.

allowDeclarations.description: Whether to allow `declare` with custom TypeScript namespaces.

allowDefinitionFiles.description: Whether to allow `declare` with custom TypeScript namespaces inside definition files.

allow.description: Patterns of import paths to allow requiring from.

allowDestructuring.description: Whether to ignore destructuring, such as `const { props, state } = this`.

allowedNames.description: Names to ignore, such as ["self"] for `const self = this;`.

checkLiteralConstAssertions.description: Whether to check literal const assertions.

typesToIgnore.description: A list of type names to ignore.

allowOptionalChaining.description: Whether to allow `?.` optional chains on `any` values.

oneOf.description: Broad setting for unused variables to target.

args.description: Whether to check all, some, or no arguments.

argsIgnorePattern.description: Regular expressions of argument names to not check for usage.

caughtErrors.description: Whether to check catch block arguments.

caughtErrorsIgnorePattern.description: Regular expressions of catch block argument names to not check for usage.

destructuredArrayIgnorePattern.description: Regular expressions of destructured array variable names to not check for usage.

enableAutofixRemoval.description: Configurable automatic fixes for different types of unused variables.

imports.description: Whether to enable automatic removal of unused imports.

ignoreClassWithStaticInitBlock.description: Whether to ignore classes with at least one static initialization block.

ignoreRestSiblings.description: Whether to ignore sibling properties in `...` destructuring.

ignoreUsingDeclarations.description: Whether to ignore using or await using declarations.

reportUsedIgnorePattern.description: Whether to report variables that match any of the valid ignore pattern options if they have been used.

vars.description: Whether to check all variables or only locally-declared variables.

varsIgnorePattern.description: Regular expressions of variable names to not check for usage.

allow.description: Type specifiers that can be thrown.

allowRethrowing.description: Whether to allow rethrowing caught values that are not `Error` objects.

allowThrowingAny.description: Whether to always allow throwing values typed as `any`.

allowThrowingUnknown.description: Whether to always allow throwing values typed as `unknown`.

allow.description: Type specifiers that can be used as Promise rejection reasons.

allowEmptyReject.description: Whether to allow calls to `Promise.reject()` with no arguments.

allowThrowingAny.description: Whether to always allow throwing values typed as `any`.

allowThrowingUnknown.description: Whether to always allow throwing values typed as `unknown`.

allowNullish.description: Whether to allow potentially `null` or `undefined` typed values.

allowNumberAndString.description: Whether to allow `bigint`/`number` typed values and `string` typed values to be added together.

skipCompoundAssignments.description: Whether to skip compound assignments such as `+=`.

allow.description: Types to allow in template expressions.

allowAny.description: Whether to allow `any` typed values in template expressions.

allowArray.description: Whether to allow `array` typed values in template expressions.

allowBoolean.description: Whether to allow `boolean` typed values in template expressions.

allowNever.description: Whether to allow `never` typed values in template expressions.

allowNullish.description: Whether to allow `nullish` typed values in template expressions.

allowNumber.description: Whether to allow `number` typed values in template expressions.

allowRegExp.description: Whether to allow `regexp` typed values in template expressions.

lib.description: What to enforce for `/// <reference lib="..." />` references.

path.description: What to enforce for `/// <reference path="..." />` references.

types.description: What to enforce for `/// <reference types="..." />` references.

ignoreStatic.description: Whether to skip checking whether `static` methods are correctly bound.

requireCatchParameter.description: Requires the catch blocks to always have the caught error parameter so it is not discarded.

errorClassNames.description: Additional error class names to check for cause preservation.
